## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Naples, Italy. It starts at Via dei Cristallini 133.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Visit the Ipogeo dei Cristallini to see where the city of Napoli began. This rare example of Hellenistic painting and architecture is in Rione Sanità-Vergini, Naples. The four chambers reveal ancient art and craft techniques through trompe l’oeil effects. Travel back 2300 years into a mysterious underground world.
>
> Through the art, learn about life and death, as well as family and friendship. Discover the unique history of the Ipogeo, which Barone Giovanni di Donato accidentally found on his property in 1889.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €13.50. It was rated 4.8 out of 5 from 5 ratings and 4 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
